name: datatechtoncrm-platform
description: DatatechtonCRM - Data-Driven CRM and Marketing Automation Platform - Microservices Architecture

scripts.test:ci: npm run test:unit -- --ci && npm run test:integration -- --ci && npm run test:e2e -- --ci
scripts.lint: npm run lint:services && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:services: for dir in services/*/; do if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] && grep -q '"lint"' "$dir/package.json"; then echo "Linting $(basename "$dir")..."; (cd "$dir" && npm run lint); else echo "Skipping $(basename "$dir") - no lint script"; fi; done
scripts.lint:frontend: if [ -d "frontend" ] && [ -f "frontend/package.json" ] && grep -q '"lint"' "frontend/package.json"; then cd frontend && npm run lint; else echo "Skipping frontend - no lint script"; fi
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:services:fix && npm run lint:frontend:fix
scripts.lint:services:fix: for dir in services/*/; do if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] && grep -q '"lint:fix"' "$dir/package.json"; then echo "Fixing lint issues in $(basename "$dir")..."; (cd "$dir" && npm run lint:fix); else echo "Skipping $(basename "$dir") - no lint:fix script"; fi; done
scripts.lint:frontend:fix: if [ -d "frontend" ] && [ -f "frontend/package.json" ] && grep -q '"lint:fix"' "frontend/package.json"; then cd frontend && npm run lint:fix; else echo "Skipping frontend - no lint:fix script"; fi
scripts.format: npm run format:services && npm run format:frontend
scripts.format:services: for dir in services/*/; do if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] && grep -q '"format"' "$dir/package.json"; then echo "Formatting $(basename "$dir")..."; (cd "$dir" && npm run format); else echo "Skipping $(basename "$dir") - no format script"; fi; done
scripts.format:frontend: if [ -d "frontend" ] && [ -f "frontend/package.json" ] && grep -q '"format"' "frontend/package.json"; then cd frontend && npm run format; else echo "Skipping frontend - no format script"; fi
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:services && npm run format:check:frontend
scripts.format:check:services: for dir in services/*/; do if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] && grep -q '"format:check"' "$dir/package.json"; then echo "Checking format in $(basename "$dir")..."; (cd "$dir" && npm run format:check); else echo "Skipping $(basename "$dir") - no format:check script"; fi; done
scripts.format:check:frontend: if [ -d "frontend" ] && [ -f "frontend/package.json" ] && grep -q '"format:check"' "frontend/package.json"; then cd frontend && npm run format:check; else echo "Skipping frontend - no format:check script"; fi
scripts.db:seed: docker-compose exec user-service npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose exec postgres psql -U datatechtoncrm -d datatechtoncrm -c "DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;" && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:services && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:services: for dir in services/*/; do (cd "$dir" && npm install); done
scripts.docs:generate: for dir in services/*/; do (cd "$dir" && npm run docs); done

author: DatatechtonCRM Team

hooks.pre-push: npm run test && npm run lint
